branding_modifications.telemetry_guard: my_branding adds a per-app import-map/module-alias guard that resolves Frappe's remote Pulse telemetry client to a local no-op module on every branded SPA (Helpdesk, Insights, CRM, Drive, Gameplan, ...). This is distinct from the v227 CRM-only source overlay in context/v229-tools/source-overlays.json, which may still apply to CRM's own frontend/index.html.
branding_modifications.pdf_guard: my_branding adds a guard that refuses to let the PlutoPrint PDF generator run, because PlutoPrint vendors its own bundled, older libcurl/openssl; the system/py-weasyprint PDF path remains in use.

image_build.form: flat: a single data layer on scratch, flattened from a stacked build
image_build.stacked_build: docker build --platform linux/amd64 on the prepared context (Dockerfile FROM the v16-prod-228 runtime image), tagged locally as nexum-stacked:v16-prod-229-rc2 (never pushed)
image_build.flatten: docker build --platform linux/amd64 --network none --pull=false of a Dockerfile that is FROM scratch, COPY --from=<stacked image> / /, and restates the stacked image configuration (ENV, LABEL, VOLUME, WORKDIR, USER, ENTRYPOINT, CMD)
image_build.identity_proof: the flat image holds exactly the stacked image filesystem (441,341 entries, 6.90 GB of regular files; 4 directory mtimes differ, no hardlink grouping difference) and an identical configuration
image_build.clean_base_step: one extra Dockerfile step removes three build caches (/home/frappe/.cache/yarn, /home/frappe/.cache/uv, /home/frappe/.local/share/pnpm/store) after the frontend builds
